description: Read the office memory: short notes every bot and the owner share between runs (customer preferences, where things live, what was tried last time). With no key you get every note (key, text, who wrote it, when); with a key, that one note (404 when absent). Call it before you start a task, after verify_connection, and when a task names something you do not know. At most 100 notes per office. Same as GET /v1/in/memory (owner key: GET /v1/workspaces/:id/memory). Next: read_messages, then list_tasks.

agent_id.description: Only on a link that is not bound to one bot: which bot is asking.

key.description: One note's key (lower-case letters, digits, _ . -; e.g. customer.acme.preferences). Leave out for every note.

name: recall
title: Recall office memory
